intro: Working from home changes everything when cats enter the equation. They're your coworkers, your managers, and occasionally your keyboard debuggers. Deadlines mean nothing to a cat who's decided your lap is the only acceptable seat in the house. Here are the furry architects behind my work-life balance (or lack thereof).

cats.name: Luna
cats.personality: Luna believes every Zoom call is an opportunity for a cameo. Her favorite move is the strategic keyboard walk during standup. She's mastered the art of looking innocent while causing maximum chaos.

ability.name: Laptop Heater
ability.description: Transforms any MacBook Pro into a personal heating pad. Bonus effect: forces you to take breaks when laptop reaches thermal throttling.

cats.name: Mochi
cats.personality: Mochi takes quality assurance seriously. Every bug in the house (and codebase) is fair game. She's the reason I have a second monitor — the first one is her observation deck.

ability.name: 3AM Deploy
ability.description: Activates zoomies at peak focus hours. Guaranteed to trigger at least one production incident per sprint.
